name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example script using the exact API code from the quickstart (text_to_speech.convert with voice_id JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb, model_id eleven_v3, output_format mp3_44100_128), and ran it. The script successfully generated a 40KB output.mp3 file (verified as MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion."
deviations: The quickstart example uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox has no audio output hardware, I saved the returned audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`) instead. The core API request and authentication were exactly as documented.
